psi_run>=2.gloss: allow bursts of at most 2 messages in a row -- i.e. forbid posting exactly when the app has already posted in each of the last 2 consecutive posting opportunities, so a burst must pause after 2 back-to-back messages (equivalently, at most 2 messages in any 3 consecutive opportunities); the total number of messages in the window is otherwise unlimited
